region.why: a deployment fact: HCAZERRS ASSIGNs SYSID into the message it writes; the corpus names no region

notes: The example-health-apis user writer HCAPDB02, LINKed with a COMMAREA: after the length checks it moves CA-PATIENT-ID to the host variable and INSERTs a USER row whose password defaults to the user id. The seed holds the PATIENT rows the foreign key needs. Tables come from the estate's @DB2CRE.jcl (HCZMSA1).
